'''Slezský FC Opava''' is a professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Opava]], Czech Republic. The club plays in the [[Czech National Football League]], the second of [[Football in Czech Republic|Czech football]] after being relegated from the [[Czech First League]] at the end of the [[2020–21 Czech First League|2020–21]] season."}}
